title: CMTC DNS
description: Is name resolution working for enrolled workloads in both clusters? CoreDNS's own exporter for the server side, the CMTC measurement plane for the client side (planned), and Cilium drops for queries that never reached CoreDNS.

panels.title: CoreDNS replicas scraped · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs the coredns scrape job of deploy/. CoreDNS Pods that answered their last scrape, per cluster. The lab runs 2 per cluster.

panels.title: Nodes running CoreDNS · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs the coredns scrape job of deploy/. Nodes that run a scraped CoreDNS replica, per cluster. 1 with 2 replicas means one node failure stops resolution for the cluster (CoreDNSReplicasOnOneNode); both lab clusters run both on the control plane.

panels.title: SERVFAIL share, 5 minutes · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs the coredns scrape job of deploy/. SERVFAIL answers as a share of all answers, per cluster. Normal: 0 %. Above 1 % for 5 minutes: CoreDNSServfailHigh.

targets.expr: (sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", rcode="SERVFAIL", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m]))) / (sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m])) > 0)

(sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", rcode="SERVFAIL", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m]))) / (sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m])) > 0)

panels.title: NXDOMAIN share, 5 minutes · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs the coredns scrape job of deploy/. NXDOMAIN answers as a share of all answers, per cluster. High is normal: each lookup of a short name tries the search domains first. On 2026-10-25 a cmtc-a replica had answered 107020 NXDOMAIN and 59271 NOERROR. Recorded, not alerted.

targets.expr: (sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", rcode="NXDOMAIN", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m]))) / (sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m])) > 0)

(sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", rcode="NXDOMAIN", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m]))) / (sum by (cluster) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m])) > 0)

panels.title: Answers per second · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs the coredns scrape job of deploy/. Answers CoreDNS sent, all response codes, per cluster, 5 minute rate.

panels.title: Requests per second · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs the coredns scrape job of deploy/. Requests CoreDNS received, all record types and transports, per cluster, 5 minute rate. It equals answers per second when every request is answered.

panels.title: Answers in the last hour, by response code · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs the coredns scrape job of deploy/. Answers by response code over the last hour. A code appears once CoreDNS first sent it.

panels.title: Requests in the last hour, by record type and transport · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs the coredns scrape job of deploy/. Requests by record type (A, AAAA, SRV, other) and transport (udp, tcp) over the last hour.

options.content: CoreDNS's own view: the queries that reached it. NXDOMAIN dominates by design; SERVFAIL is the error signal.

panels.title: Answer time, median, seconds · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs the coredns scrape job of deploy/. Median time CoreDNS took to answer, per cluster, from its histogram over 5 minutes (buckets from 0.25 ms). No value when nothing was answered.

panels.title: Answer time, 99th percentile, seconds · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs the coredns scrape job of deploy/. 99th percentile answer time, per cluster, 5 minutes. The latency objective is 99 % within 64 ms (docs/METRICS_AND_SLOS.md).

panels.title: Each CoreDNS replica, now · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs the coredns scrape job of deploy/. One row per replica over the last 5 minutes: answers per second, median and 99th percentile answer time, SERVFAIL per second, cache hit share, CPU cores and resident memory. Replicas of a cluster should read alike.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (cluster, node, pod, le) (rate(coredns_dns_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="coredns"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (cluster, node, pod, le) (rate(coredns_dns_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="coredns"}[5m])))
sum by (cluster, node, pod) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns", rcode="SERVFAIL"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (cluster, node, pod) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{job="coredns"}[5m]))
sum by (cluster, node, pod) (rate(coredns_cache_hits_total{job="coredns"}[5m])) / (sum by (cluster, node, pod) (rate(coredns_cache_requests_total{job="coredns"}[5m])) > 0)

options.content: Percentiles come from CoreDNS's buckets, not an average. A replica slower than its neighbour points at its node.

panels.description: Proposed: needs the coredns scrape job of deploy/. Queries CoreDNS forwarded to its upstream resolvers (names outside the cluster), per cluster, 5 minute rate.

panels.title: Forward answer time, 99th percentile, seconds · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs the coredns scrape job of deploy/. 99th percentile time the upstream took to answer, per cluster, 5 minutes.

panels.title: Forwarded answers in the last hour, by upstream and response code · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs the coredns scrape job of deploy/. Upstream answers by upstream address and response code over the last hour.

panels.title: Faults in the last hour, per replica · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs the coredns scrape job of deploy/. Per replica over the last hour: forward health checks that found every upstream broken, queries refused at the forward concurrency limit, recovered panics and failed Corefile reloads. All 0 is normal; each has its own alert.

options.content: On the lab every replica forwards to the node's resolver. SERVFAIL with healthy forwarding points at the kubernetes plugin.

panels.title: Do enrolled Pods get answers? · planned
Queries without an answer, share · planned
panels.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs the CMTC measurement plane (#36, ADR-005; its names are in metrics/contract.json). Share of DNS queries (UDP and TCP, to port 53 or to ztunnel's DNS proxy on 15053) sent by enrolled Pods that got no answer, per cluster, 5 minute rate, measured at the client's own node. CoreDNS cannot see a query dropped before it. UDP retries count as queries.

targets.expr: clamp_min(1 - ((sum by (cluster) (rate(cmtc_measurement_dns_answers_total{job="cmtc", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (cluster) (rate(cmtc_measurement_dns_queries_total{job="cmtc", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m]))) / (sum by (cluster) (rate(cmtc_measurement_dns_queries_total{job="cmtc", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m])) > 0)), 0)

clamp_min(1 - ((sum by (cluster) (rate(cmtc_measurement_dns_answers_total{job="cmtc", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (cluster) (rate(cmtc_measurement_dns_queries_total{job="cmtc", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m]))) / (sum by (cluster) (rate(cmtc_measurement_dns_queries_total{job="cmtc", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m])) > 0)), 0)

panels.title: Client-side answer time, 99th percentile, seconds · planned
panels.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs the CMTC measurement plane (#36, ADR-005; its names are in metrics/contract.json). Time from an enrolled Pod's query to its answer, as the client's node measures it, per cluster, 5 minutes. Includes the network path CoreDNS cannot see.

panels.title: Namespaces whose queries got no answer, last minute · planned
panels.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs the CMTC measurement plane (#36, ADR-005; its names are in metrics/contract.json). Nodes and namespaces where enrolled Pods sent queries and received no answer in the last minute: the condition of CMTCEnrolledPodDNSUnanswered. Labels stop at the namespace: per-Pod detail never goes into a metric label (ADR-005). The plane's namespace label reads exported_namespace here, because the scrape sets namespace to the node agent's own.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, node, exported_namespace) (increase(cmtc_measurement_dns_queries_total{job="cmtc"}[1m])) > 0 unless on (cluster, node, exported_namespace) sum by (cluster, node, exported_namespace) (increase(cmtc_measurement_dns_answers_total{job="cmtc"}[1m])) > 0

panels.title: Measurement plane ready, per node · planned
panels.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs the CMTC measurement plane (#36, ADR-005; its names are in metrics/contract.json). Whether the measurement plane on each node is attached and fresh. Not ready means the panels above are unavailable for that node, not zero.

options.content: The 2026-10-25 failure: an enrolled Pod's queries were dropped at its own node's egress gate while CoreDNS stayed healthy. Only this client side shows it.

panels.title: Packets dropped for policy per second, egress · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs cilium_drop_count_total and cilium_forward_count_total in the cilium-native keep list of deploy/. Packets the Cilium datapath dropped leaving a Pod with reason Policy denied, per cluster, 5 minute rate. The 2026-10-25 DNS drops were of this kind; the counter cannot tell DNS from other traffic.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (rate(cilium_drop_count_total{job="cilium-native", direction="EGRESS", reason="Policy denied", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m]))
sum by (cluster) (rate(cilium_drop_count_total{job="cilium-native", direction="EGRESS", reason="Policy denied", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m]))

panels.title: Packets forwarded per second · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs cilium_drop_count_total and cilium_forward_count_total in the cilium-native keep list of deploy/. Packets the Cilium datapath forwarded, both directions, per cluster, 5 minute rate: the scale for the drops beside it.

panels.title: Drops in the last hour, by node, direction and reason · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs cilium_drop_count_total and cilium_forward_count_total in the cilium-native keep list of deploy/. Dropped packets by node, direction and reason over the last hour.

options.content: Drops have no port label: a rise of egress Policy denied drops with healthy CoreDNS is a hint, the client side is the proof.
